de.name: Siegel der Infektion
de.description: Wenn der Gegner blutet, leidet er 13...20 Sekunden lang an Krankheit.
de.concise: Verursacht Zustand Krankheit (13...20 Sekunden), falls der Gegner blutet.

en.name: Signet of Infection
en.description: If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13...20 seconds.
en.concise: Inflicts Diseased condition 13...20 seconds if target foe is Bleeding.
